independenceStatement: This reviewer did not author or modify the reviewed production UI or immutable browser collection. The reviewer wrote only the assigned reviewer-report.json and reviewer-report.md and did not touch production UI, collection inputs, frozen design artifacts, specifications, task checkboxes, owner artifacts, Git staging, or commits.

buildIdentity.displayScaleBasis: The 1280x760 PNG equals the recorded 1280x760 CSS viewport; this is the browser capture scale and is not a claim about a physical macOS display.

reviewedCollections.role: semantic browser authority and fixed browser screenshot

visualChecks.check: The primary New Drawing action uses the frozen high-contrast leading-icon treatment
visualChecks.expected: White 16x16 New Drawing glyph on the #6965DB primary surface, matching the frozen baseline and accent-contrast role.
visualChecks.actual: The glyph is rendered black/dark on the purple primary surface while the adjacent text remains white.

visualChecks.check: Recent Workspaces rows use the restrained flat semantic surface shown in the frozen baseline
visualChecks.expected: Flat row surfaces with subtle semantic border treatment; the reference Architecture row carries the light hover/active surface without native button beveling.
visualChecks.actual: All three rows show a pronounced dark right/bottom bevel, and Architecture lacks the reference filled surface.

visualChecks.check: Welcome content preserves the approved vertical hierarchy and rhythm
visualChecks.expected: The Recent heading is separated from the action row by the larger reference interval and remains visually grouped with its rows.
visualChecks.actual: The Recent heading is pulled materially closer to the action row while the gap before the rows is enlarged, changing the reference grouping and hierarchy.

visualChecks.check: Approved Recent semantic deviation is respected
visualChecks.expected: Recent rows show only name and rootPath; drawing-count and last-opened metadata from the screenshot are omitted.
visualChecks.actual: Only name and rootPath are visible. The approved omission is not treated as a mismatch.

compositionChecks.check: Compact Sidebar and Back controls remain at the far-left top shell layer
Welcome hero, two actions, Recent section, and non-persistent-state note are all present
Primary action visual emphasis and icon contrast match the baseline
Recent section grouping and row surfaces match the baseline composition
No shell region is hidden by an SDK mask

legacyRemoval.control: large textual Pin or Unpin control
persistent normal-state All changes saved strip
Unicode placeholder tree or file icons

maskRationale: The immutable mask declaration contains no masks. HF2-01 Welcome exposes no SDK-owned editor, Library, or Presentation interior that requires masking, so the full shell capture was reviewed.

tolerances.browserGeometryTolerance: ±2 CSS px; owned by the bound collector and not re-proved from the screenshot

rasterOnlyTolerance.scope: collector-owned auxiliary welcome-screen component crop only

findings.expected: The New Drawing action has a white leading document glyph on the purple primary surface, matching the frozen baseline and the primary action contrast treatment.
findings.actual: The New Drawing glyph is black/dark on the purple surface while its label remains white, producing an unapproved contrast and emphasis mismatch.
findings.reproduction: Open the bound baseline and actual.png at 100% and compare the New Drawing leading glyph near x=176..194, y=318..336. The baseline glyph is white; the actual glyph is black/dark.

findings.expected: Recent rows use flat semantic surfaces with restrained subtle borders; the reference Architecture row uses the light filled hover/active surface.
findings.actual: All three rows show a pronounced dark right/bottom bevel characteristic of an unreset browser button, and the Architecture row lacks the reference filled surface.
findings.reproduction: Open the bound baseline and actual.png at 100% and compare the three Recent row perimeters and Architecture row fill. In actual.png the right and bottom edges are visibly dark on every row.

findings.screenState: 01 · Welcome · Light / Recent section vertical composition
findings.expected: The Recent section keeps the frozen baseline rhythm: a larger separation after the action group and a tighter visual grouping between the Recent heading/subtitle and the first row.
findings.actual: The heading moves materially closer to the actions while the first row is separated farther from the heading/subtitle, weakening the intended grouping.
findings.reproduction: Open the bound baseline and actual.png at 100% and compare the vertical intervals between the action row, Recent Workspaces heading/subtitle, and first Recent row.

residualLowMediumFindings: HF2-01-VIS-002: Recent row surfaces use a pronounced native-looking bevel and omit the reference Architecture-row filled surface.
HF2-01-VIS-003: Recent section vertical grouping differs materially from the frozen composition.
unverified: A native macOS package, bundle identifier, native window, physical display scale, native menus, and system dialogs were not reviewed; they are intentionally outside this intermediate browser-only checkpoint.
The recorded capture scale is derived from matching PNG and CSS viewport dimensions and does not establish the physical macOS display scale.

Behavior, persistence, keyboard operation, accessible names, focus-visible, loading, disabled, error, five-row overflow, and legacy counts were not re-proved from pixels; the immutable semantic collector owns those facts.
HF2-05 and the other four HF-2 screens were not reviewed by this single-screen checkpoint.
No product-owner decision was created or inferred because ownerRequirement is NOT_REQUIRED for HF2-01.
nextGate: Implementation remediation for the primary-action glyph color, Recent row surface reset/state fidelity, and Recent section spacing; then create a new immutable HF2-01 browser collection bound to the remediation commit and obtain another independent reviewer verdict.
